t: Productive bees expand on the vanilla hive with an Advanced Hive. Unlike the vanilla hive, the advanced hive does not require a campfire nearby to be harvestable it can be broken and moved with the bees still inside without the use of silk touch.
资源蜜蜂在原版蜂巢的基础上扩展出了高级蜂箱。与原版蜂巢不同，高级蜂箱不需要附近有营火才能安全采集；即使没有精准采集，你也可以在蜜蜂仍留在里面时直接将其破坏并搬走。
There are many variants of advanced beehives available depending on other woods are available in your pack.
根据你的整合包中可用的其他木材种类，还有许多不同变种的高级蜂箱可供使用。

Advanced Hives features a GUI from where you can see which bees are currently inside the hive as well as take out any produced resources. Advanced Hives can be further upgraded using an $(l:hives/expansion_boxes)expansion box$(/l). Attaching an $(l:hives/expansion_boxes)expansion box$(/l) will increase the bee capacity from 3 to 5 and allow $(l:items/upgrades)upgrades$(/l) to be installed.
高级蜂箱带有一个 GUI，你可以在其中查看当前在蜂箱内的蜜蜂，并取出已产出的资源。高级蜂箱还可以通过$(l:hives/expansion_boxes)扩容盒$(/l)进一步升级。连接一个$(l:hives/expansion_boxes)扩容盒$(/l)后，蜜蜂容量会从 3 提升到 5，并允许安装$(l:items/upgrades)升级$(/l)。

If you're tired of waiting for the bees to finish their job and get out of the hive, you can whack the hive or nest with a stick to force it out, losing all production progress. This only works if it's safe for the bees to exit.
如果你不想再等蜜蜂干完活从蜂箱里出来，可以用木棍敲打蜂箱或蜂巢，强制把它们赶出来，但会损失所有当前的生产进度。只有在蜜蜂能够安全离开时，这种方法才有效。
